Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000548" [constraint]: Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)

- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000377": The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000409" [decision]: As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000448" [decision]: The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000405": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher's runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000654": On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the authentication gateway handover document for Diego.  (about: Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000215" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000454": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000314": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1000615" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000701" [decision]: The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000368" [decision]: Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
